top_signals.headline: WEF: Mixed female teams doubled to $74B in 2025 (18.4% of VC), but exclusively female-founded still 2%
top_signals.summary: Per WEF analysis, mixed female-founder teams attracted $74B in 2025 (18.4% of VC capital), nearly double 2024. Exclusively female-founded teams still hold roughly 2% of capital. Doubling driven by AI mega-rounds.

top_signals.headline: 500 Global promoted Iris Sun to Partner - now in <5% of VCs with majority-women partnership
top_signals.summary: 500 Global elevated Iris Sun to Partner, putting the firm among fewer than 5% of VC firms with a majority-women partnership.

top_signals.headline: inDrive launched Aurora Ventures - $180-250K pre-seed for emerging markets women
top_signals.summary: inDrive formally launched Aurora Ventures with $180-250K pre-seed/seed checks for women founders in MENA, Africa, LatAm and emerging Asia. Led by Isabella Ghassemi-Smith.

top_signals.headline: Sephi Shapira on agreeableness: female founders get funded once they say no
top_signals.summary: Na'Ama Moran's interview with Sephi Shapira argues agreeableness is the single largest behavioral factor in the female founder funding gap. 'Be agreeable when managing people, lean towards being disagreeable when raising funds.' Anchored to PitchBook March 2026 All In.

top_signals.headline: Frontier Health UK closed 12M GBP seed led by Atomico (Rachel Finegold, AI healthtech)
top_signals.summary: Frontier Health, led by founder/CEO Rachel Finegold, closed a 12M GBP seed round led by Atomico - one of the largest European female-CEO AI healthtech rounds this month.
